# Ezekiel 26 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 26:19 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | For thus says the-Lord YHWH: 'When-I-make-you a-desolate city, like-the-cities which are-not-inhabited, when-I-bring-up the-deep upon-you and-the-great waters cover-you,' |
| LOGOS | For thus says the Lord GOD: When I make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep over you, and the great waters cover you, |
| PNEUMA | The Sovereign LORD says: I will turn you into a deserted ruin, like cities where no one lives. I will bury you beneath the rising ocean waves. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
